title: PostgreSQL
summary: A powerful open-source relational database: tables and constraints, joins, indexes, transactions, JSONB, window functions and production basics.
outcomes: Create databases and tables with the right types and constraints
Query, join and summarise data, with upserts and RETURNING
Speed up queries with indexes and read EXPLAIN
Use transactions safely and understand ACID, MVCC and locks
Store flexible data with JSONB and arrays
Back up, secure and connect to Postgres from Python

chapters.summary: Install, create tables, and query data.
